# Minimal CI unit test allowlist.
#
# This is NOT "tests/*.test.ts" (that glob is 494 files; several are known
# unstable in CI per the task brief: tests/market-annotation.test.ts has 5
# pre-existing failures against stale source-text regex assertions,
# tests/customer-service-read-scope.test.ts has UI state-machine tests that
# run close to a 30s per-test budget, and a full-suite run has previously
# hung for 20+ minutes near tests/customer-service-store-selection-interaction.test.ts
# even though that file passes in isolation in ~3s). Running the full glob
# blind was explicitly out of scope for this task.
#
# Every file below was run individually in the session that added this CI
# workflow and passed cleanly and quickly (session date 2026-10-28, against
# origin/main @ eee72b72). This is a deliberately small, verified core set:
# general sanity coverage plus the two most recent, most fragile fixes this
# CI exists to protect (worker same-origin gate / CSRF, and the Excel parse
# size boundaries added in commit 32992466).
#
# To add a file: run it standalone with `node --import tsx --test
# --test-timeout=30000 tests/<file>`, confirm it passes in well under the
# job timeout, then add its path here.
